reading: DataVerge is a privately held, carrier-neutral interconnection data center operator founded in 2003 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. Its primary facility sits in the Industry City complex in Sunset Park, Brooklyn, spanning 50,000 square feet with roughly 3 megawatts of capacity per third-party directory tracking, and markets itself as the only carrier-neutral interconnection data center in Brooklyn, hosting more than 40 carriers and network providers alongside direct connections to AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. DataVerge operates a secondary backup and disaster recovery facility in Jersey City, New Jersey, giving tri-state area customers a redundant site for business continuity planning. The company states it owns and operates its facilities directly, though it does not publish further detail on its capitalization or investor structure. DataVerge's positioning as a dense interconnection hub for carriers and cloud on-ramps in an outer-borough New York City location is a similar model to other metro interconnection specialists, distinct from the wholesale power-dense campuses built by national hyperscale developers elsewhere in this registry.
